title: Paper Tower · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper Tower · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead two sheets of paper and a clear table. The lead folds or rolls the sheets into a freestanding tower without tape. The tower stands unsupported for five seconds. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Two sheets of paper.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper Tower, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The tower stands unsupported for five seconds.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The tower stands unsupported for five seconds.
